text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, there's an architecture exhibition 
going on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, Believe 
stopped in front of a poster.
choice_data_list: Want to go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm going. What about you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Want to go take a look?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? There's a shed built in the garden. 
Is it part of the exhibition, I wonder?
choice_data_list: I'll go too!
I'll go too!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's head inside.
choice_data_list: Looks like they put together a pre...
Looks like they put together a rea...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...! I see, they recreated and displayed 
the building where those building 
materials were used—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, looking at this,
you can even tell 
how much care went into making it
suitable 
for daily life back then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although the exhibits are parts of 
structures like walls and stairs, they've 
been installed within a recreated space. 
Seeing them as the building looked back 
then makes it very easy to understand.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
This place... is it an old European 
factory? Maybe back in the heyday of 
steelmaking.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...The ironworking technique really is 
outstanding after all. Even in modern 
times,
replicating this mechanism would be 
difficult."
choice_data_list:
So you're well-versed in Western 
...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I've only just scratched the surface, 
really. I started watching once it was 
decided my grandfather would move to 
America.
choice_data_list: You're quite knowledgeable about W...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Differences in environment and lifestyle 
are reflected in their works, which makes 
it quite fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
This has the architecture of a
traditional 
inn. The lattice... uses fixed windows, 
not sliding doors.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Is this red ochre paint...? The border 
with the wall's plaster was painted with 
aging in mind.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's also a trick to keep the
paint 
from peeling off—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believe took her time admiring the 
exhibits.
Several hours were about to pass 
since entering the museum.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a sign pointing ahead toward 
the "On-Site Cafe" caught my eye.
choice_data_list: Believe, shall we take a little br...
Believe, wanna take a little break...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, really. Trainer,
please go ahead 
and rest.
choice_data_list: Believe, why don't we take a short...
Believe, want to take a short brea...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Even an old Western castle...! I'm 
grateful to be able to see this 
domestically.
choice_data_list: Ah... well then, let's meet up at ...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(The way I spoke to Trainer just now... 
Was I being rude, I wonder...?)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I should have just said that I wanted to 
spend all our time looking at the 
exhibits...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...I wonder if I made them feel 
uncomfortable.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spend some relaxing time at the quiet 
café inside the facility. I wonder if 
Believe is enjoying the tour.
choice_data_list: (Of course she can't really look a...
(She can't really browse freely wi...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She probably won't be back until right 
before closing time, so I might as well 
check out the museum shop.
choice_data_list: (If I'm around, it'd be harder for...
(It'd be hard for her to look arou...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: This room is... Ah, the museum shop...
choice_data_list: Welcome back, Believe! Did you get...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Um—
choice_data_list: Welcome back, Believe! Did you get...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Souvenirs?
choice_data_list: Look, I found a souvenir you might...
Look, I found a souvenir you might...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I place the coaster and pitcher I had 
picked out beforehand in front of her.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
A coaster with a mosaic pattern, is it? I 
wonder if it's handmade... It has a nice 
warmth to it. The color combination is 
beautiful, too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I think this water pitcher is made of
tin. 
It has quite an antique feel to it.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Still, tin loses its plating easily, so 
it's not very practical. It would really 
only work as a vase... Oh.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Did I... say something unpleasant 
again...?)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I just reflected on this and 
told myself to be careful...!)
choice_data_list: I see, so you care about practical...
I see, so you value practicality a...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes... Tools are meant to be used, 
after all.
choice_data_list: I see, so you value practicality a...
I see, you value practicality as well.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...Such earnest eyes. A smile completely 
free of lies.)
choice_data_list: True, that's so like Believe!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Trainer really is something else...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (It all shows on your face, you know.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Both show wonderful craftsmanship. 
Which one catches your eye, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: A mosaic-patterned coaster
Antique-style pitcher

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told them that I liked the colorful 
mosaic pattern.
choice_data_list: A mosaic-patterned coaster
Antique-style water pitcher

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Then you'd probably like stained glass as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I don't really have much of an eye for 
colors, you see.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If I ever get stuck on color
combinations, 
maybe I'll ask Trainer for advice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell them that I prefer retro,
elaborate 
designs, like medieval antiques or 
steampunk styles.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the intricate patterns on this
pitcher 
are truly exquisite, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, do you also favor 
architecture with exquisite sculptures?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Tell me about your favorite 
architecture... on our way back.
